about: A record that may be absent (docs/adr/0055, step 9): `pick` is an optional record that starts absent, taken whole from a payload, from a record variable and from a list's element, read as `pick.value.title` and `pick.value.count` only where a test proves it present (an <if> with its <else>, `&&`, a conditional), written as `pick.value.count` and `pick.value.title` under one test, made absent again by `null`, and `found` takes what an algorithm answers, the first item of the list that holds at least 5 or an absent record. A record put into `pick` is a copy: the list keeps the item as it was when `pick` was bumped. The list holds three: a fourth item appends nothing, nothing after the append runs (`pick` and `draft` stay), and error.execution is raised. A field's int32 and uint32 are numbers; an absent record is `null`. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: nothing picked yet: `pick` and `found` start absent, `draft` holds the record it was built with
an empty list holds no item that reaches 5: the algorithm answers an absent record
an item whole from the payload into `pick`, and into the list and `draft` besides
the one item holds 2, short of 5, so the answer is still absent
a second item replaces what `pick` holds, and joins the list
present: the `<if>` reads its fields, `&&` and the conditional read the count, and `pick === null` is false
two fields written under one test: the count 6 becomes 7, and the title `bumped`; the record is still present for the second write
the fields read are the ones written
the second item of the list, as the list holds it (6), is the first to reach 5: the algorithm answers it whole
absent: the `<else>` is read, `&&` is false before it reads a field, the conditional answers 0, and `pick === null` is true
nothing is written through an absent record: the test around the writes is false
a record variable taken whole: `draft` holds the second item
a third item fills the list, and is `pick` and `draft` too
a list's element taken whole: index 1 is the second item, and `draft` stays the third
a fourth item does not fit the three the list holds: the append fails first, nothing after it runs, and error.execution says so
the list of three still answers its first item that holds 5 or more: the second
